title: cymbopogon pubescens
intro: Cymbopogon pubescens, commonly known as the woolly lemongrass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and anxiety, improving digestion, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cymbopogon pubescens include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help in relieving muscle spasms, promoting relaxation, and protecting against infections. The bioactive constituents of the woolly lemongrass plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
